claim: In all other supported Regions, the Publish API throttle per account is 300 messages per second for standard topics and 3,000 messages per second for FIFO topics.
question: SNS publish throughput per account (messages per second) in all other Regions?

qualifiers.scope: per account, per Region (all other supported Regions); Publish and PublishBatch combined
qualifiers.condition: A soft limit increase can be requested through an SNS quota increase request.
